scope.sourceScope: Source-first audit of the assigned first 14 original MM table candidates; no edits to the frozen 317-unit ledger, production fields, source citations, viewer crops or catalogs.
scope.productScopeBoundary: README.md:85 explicitly says MM/MM2 dependencies do not establish a searchable monster catalogue or visual verification of those books. Full creature profiles and profile-bound procedures are excluded as a product feature, but a finite table that supports an existing live general rule/equipment surface is evaluated separately rather than blanket-excluded.
scope.excludedScopeDoesNotMean: No statement that these profiles/tables are semantically complete, or that no other page of MM remains unreviewed.

method.sourceReview: Actual full-page source render pixels at 216 dpi were inspected one image/result. Two bounded magnification crops (printed pp.30 and 53) were used for exact numeric table readings; crop bounds and hashes are recorded below.
method.tooling: PyMuPDF full-page render at Matrix(3,3), plus PIL-only local crop/magnification from the canonical rendered page; no OCR used to assert table contents.
method.siteJoin: For exact current owners, checked sourceRecord, visible detail/source controls, and actual publicSearch documents from the frozen capture. Search/lexical co-occurrence alone is not used as identity proof.
method.statusVocabularies: Original source-unit review closure is distinct from scope disposition. `excluded` is a documented current product boundary; `absent` is used only for a finite in-scope table with exact bounded source rows and no current owner fields; `partial` preserves a related but unjoined live rule/source dependency.

crossCuttingConsumerAndEconomicFindings.finding: The rule says creature-specific rules still need checking. MM p.30 has a dragon-specific Subduing a Dragon procedure on the same page as the breath chart, but the current rule has no MM p.30 source reference. Preserve as a possible scoped-in source link; this author review does not claim the MM procedure is currently reproduced or used.
MM p.30 dragon sale price is already visually recorded and explicitly excluded by the public-profile feature boundary; it is not a purchase-price or general combat rule.

Five costs for classic MM golem creation are typed as gp costs in the separate economic closure and explicitly excluded. The p.49 Stone Golem continuation is present in the newly reviewed source imagery; the old table-candidate page locator omitted that continuation.
That spell’s MM example is Giant Wasp p.99, not the p.9 Giant Beetle matrix.
Blink cites Blink Dog pp.10–11, not ordinary War/Wild dog variants at p.29.
Minor Creation cites Djinni pp.28–29; page 29 co-presence with the Dragon entry is not a Dragon source join.
